decision_cruda.rationale: E569-01 stopped (ventilation 5-8h), so LH-03 is idle. Under RESERVE-01 it can activate a reserve. Este isn't truck-limited: inflow 33 plus 38.5 is about 71.5 t/h against 72 t/h truck capacity, and the stockpile is 111 of 450 t. RS-E595-01 (9.8 g/t, 293 t, 0.5 h activation, LH514 at 38.5 t/h) gives about 250 t, or about 79 oz, by 17:00. RS-E595-03 (6.2 g/t) gives only about 46 oz. No loans, so no other place loses production. No source conflict, so no confirmation is needed.
